description: Spec conformance gap list derived from _specs/app.md audit. Prioritized changes needed to make code match the described application behavior.

issues.title: Allow Ralph to run from any Git repository
issues.description: Replace the current bare-worktree-root requirement with validation that Ralph is invoked inside a Git repository, and print a clear error if not.

issues.title: Align run workflow to spec-defined step order
issues.description: Remove spawn from the required `run` workflow (or make it optional) so `run` executes the spec sequence: research, plan, validate, implement, review, publish.

issues.title: Fix single-step command execution context
issues.description: Update standalone command context resolution so `ralph research|plan|validate|implement|review|publish` runs against the current repository context instead of forcing `${root}/${issueId}` worktree paths.

issues.title: Switch Plan default agent from Claude to Codex
issues.description: Update default plan-step config and help text so the Plan phase runs with Codex by default, matching the application spec.

issues.title: Implement spec-compliant config variable substitution
issues.description: Support `${id}`, `${title}`, and `${description}` substitutions and apply substitution to both YAML front-matter and prompt body before execution.

issues.title: Adopt NNN_topic_name.md workflow artifact naming
issues.description: Align research/plan/review/implement artifact naming and validation with the RPI convention (`NNN_topic_name.md`) instead of issue-id-prefixed filenames.

issues.title: Add per-step coding-agent override support
issues.description: Allow each workflow step to override which coding agent command is used at runtime, as required by the spec.

issues.title: Enforce git read-only restrictions in Review and Publish
issues.description: Add explicit tool/command restrictions so Review and Publish steps permit git read commands but block git write/edit commands.

issues.title: Harden publish verification completion gating
issues.description: Fail closed unless publish verification output explicitly indicates full completion, instead of relying on permissive string heuristics.

issues.title: Enforce Implement success criteria postconditions
issues.description: Verify plan completion, required tests, and passing checks as concrete postconditions for Implement success rather than only external process exit status.

issues.title: Update README and CLI help text to match spec behavior
issues.description: Correct documented workflow, default agent mapping, prerequisite wording, and artifact naming guidance to reflect spec-defined behavior.

issues.title: De-scope spawn config from core spec workflow
issues.description: Remove or clearly separate `config/spawn.md` from the core spec-defined workflow surface to avoid divergence and confusion.
